notes.title: Farmtale v. 2.0.1 - Music Pack, Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
We have added further improvements to Farmtale, both Quality of Life improvements as well as bug fixes. Thanks a lot for reporting any bugs that you may come by. Or any frustrating gameplay mechanic you want to see improved. We will do our best to make this game better day by day.

The standalone downloadable music pack content is now available on the Farmtale Store page! Enjoy the music from our amazing composer ːsteamhappyː

Bug Fixes
- Farmers could get stuck in the ocean water. The building radius is reduced slightly to not spawn farmers in the water.

- Farmers could be "confused" and stand there doing nothing for no reason.

- Sometimes the reassigning of farmers did not work.

- Sometimes you would get a message saying "Can't build because it's blocking the path" even though that was not the case.

- You could pick up a building while building in progress

- Animals would sometimes be invisible when reaching level 3 feed level.

- All translations have been fixed (with possibly one or two words still missing)

- Fixed the memory crash issue when using the Experience Boost and Speed Boost. These are again enabled in the game.

- The Cosmetics Ship and Santa would for some reason not appear anymore in the mid-game. They have found their way back to the island again.

- Quest tracking has been optimized and will disable tracking when completed to decrease lag for the overall game. The game will run slightly faster.

- Removed lag when collecting Material, both from trees and from the Scrap Collectors.



Quality of Life Improvements
- The game camera can now be rotated using the + and - button.

- You can now use Q and E to zoom in and out

- Completed quests will now appear at the top of the quest list and disappear to the bottom when you claim the reward.

- Added an arrow above the building in "Building Mode" to show you what is the front of the building for a better user experience.

- You can now change between the tools in the toolbar using the 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 keys on your keyboard.

- Added a "Sell all items in category" in the top part of your inventory. Pressing the button will make it possible for you to sell all items in that category instead of one by one. This is especially useful for the animal products.



Things that are maybe fixed
- You would get a memory crash when planting a large crop farm. This has to yet be tested as it might have been fixed when fixing the Boosts and the quest tracking optimization.

- The information pop-up to the bottom left would "flash" for one second and disappear.



Planned to-do list
- Add an option to feed the animals through the Wardrobe view.

- Make the farmers water the crops for you.

- Display all achievements even when they are not completed.

- Make the tutorial more in-depth

- Add the ability to change mouse sensitivity

- Add the ability to use a default mouse cursor

- Add Tower Defense event.

notes.title: Farmtale v. 2.0.0 - Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone in this community for reporting bugs and suggesting a lot of good improvements. You've been very helpful! We have fixed most of the reported bugs and added quality of life improvements to make the gameplay more enjoyable.

- You can't build on the waterfall rocks anymore.

- You can't build in the ocean anymore.

- The Cosmetic Ship now appears less frequently.

- Removed vine 2D art from the inventory decoration that was blocking the categories.

- Scrap Material value clamped to not get negative value which would bug the game.

- Scrap collectors set to max 12.

- Scrap collector gain amount reduced to about 45%.

- Santa doesn't get stuck on crops anymore.

- Rain would only water crops the first time it rained. Now it works properly. The crops will always get watered when raining.

- You could place Speed & Experience boosts on the map like normal items which was not intended.

- Farmers are now less annoying when you are moving the farm and trying to place it.

- Some of the tree stumps could not be shoveled until you relogged.

- Farmers can now be assigned to work on a specific animal farm instead of closest. This is done by using the Right Mouse Button on the farmer.

- Sometimes scrap collectors could bug and get invisible.

- 2 of the quests were not working.

- 2 of the quests were not saving.

- The items & buildings you place now check if they can be placed before placing them so you don't get a random error.

- When you sell a house or farmer hut, the farmer/villager will now despawn with it.

- Silos increasing drop speed is working again.

- All Steam achievements and counters have been fixed and loads properly.

- Collision on crops increased so it's easier to plant crops. It's less precise.

- Fish doesn't drop things underwater.

- Wood chopping at the beach won't drop the wood under the sand.

- Visual bug with plants showing 4 levels (through icons) is now reduced to 3 levels as intended.

- Great optimization for inventory updates (fixes inventory cards flashing).

- Inventory items were frustrating to drag out. Drag out would be cancelled randomly sometimes.

- Farmers now prioritizes to loot the animal products if there are more than 10 of them on the ground. This will avoid too many items on the ground, lag and crashes.

- The hitbox for feeding animals is slightly increased so feeding animals is less frustrating.

- You can now drop the food on an animal and choose how much you want to feed it. Previously you had to drag the food one by one onto the animal.

- You can now pick up everything and sell it from the inventory by using Right Mouse Button. Shops and farms can't be picked up.

- Fixes inventory to not be click-through and accidentally opening buildings like the barn.

- The Speed & Experience boost timers would show "1 minute" again when it exceeded 60 minutes.

- The used Speed & Experience boosts would disappear and be lost when logging out. They now save properly.

- The Scrap Material amount would display 0 when relogging and correct itself when you gain Scrap Material. Now it shows the correct amount on relogging.

- The camera could get stuck when moving it behind the waterfall rocks.

- The Cosmetic shop would display wrong items that are not present in the shop.

- Assigning farmers to different farms will now save when you quit and rejoin the game.

- You can now have 4 farmers per farmer hut if you upgrade their limit. This will make it so you don't have to build 8+ huts. 2 huts will be sufficient with full upgrades.

- You can now have 4 villagers per house if you upgrade their limit. This way you don't have to build many houses which takes a lot of space.

- You can't use the shovel tool anymore at the loot box area.

- Fixed an exploit where you could sell an item and still place it in your farm.

- The game will give you the Experience gained when your game is minimized and prevent memory crashes.

- Added an experience display on the animal feeding XP bar.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1: Bug fixes and Refinements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First and foremost thanks a lot for your amazing support. We really appreciate every bit of it. This update contains all the bug fixes and refinements taken place after the release of Farmtale. At the very end you can read more about future plans and what features we want to implement.

Bug Fixes Since Release

Frequent game crashes: A game crash would occur with "Fatal Error!" a couple of times every hour. This was the most frustrating bug to deal with because the crash logs didn't give us clues to what was wrong. Luckily our programmer found the issue 2 days after the launch date.

Not gaining Material while being offline: The offline display would tell you how much Material you received while being offline, but that amount was not added to your Material counter.

Steam achievements not working properly: The achievements were not linked correctly to the events in the game and the counter was not working as intended.

Stopped receiving mails upon relog: When logging off and in for the first time, the player would not receive mails from the mailbox anymore.

Mailbox giving 12 coins sometimes: The mailbox would sometimes give 12 coins during the game which was only supposed to happen during the tutorial.

The pirate ship timer showing -01: When building the pirate ship, the timer would show -01 and would instantly build the pirate ship upon relog.

The pirate ship timer not counting down when being offline: Since the pirate ship build timer is long, it was important that the pirate ship counter still counted down when the player went offline.

Pigs and farmer getting stuck: The pig and the farmer would sometimes get stuck in the large plate item bought from the coin shop.

Scraps not being clickable sometimes: The scraps would sometimes get stuck beneath invisible items and therefore not being lootable anymore.

Water looking white in low resolution: The water shader would be completely white when playing with medium or low texture resolution.

Danish language displayed wrong offline earnings: When selecting the Danish language, the offline earnings would display wrong static numbers for how much Coins and Material were earned while being offline.

We are still missing a bug where an animal will disappear all of a sudden during gameplay but reappear when the player relogs. If you have this bug, please send us a screenshot of your farm and maybe on how your animal disappeared if you observed anything. We want to reproduce the bug. ːsteamfacepalmː

Refinements Since Release

Chicken Farm income reduced: The Chicken Farm was very strong from level 1 till level 100. This made every other farm feel pointless and therefore the income was reduced towards a more balanced gameplay.

Duck Farm income increased: The Duck Farm didn't give enough coins for the cost value and therefore we gave the income a small push.

Workshop experience cost increased: The Workshop was too easy to level up compared to all the other farms. Therefore it has been made more expensive but gives also much more income to compensate for the cost. We understand that other Material sources should be available in the game.

Reduced offline earnings: The amount of currency achieved offline was too high which didn't encourage players to play the game. The amount of currency you get while being offline has been reduced but might need to be rebalanced again.

Golden profit items buffed: The golden items that the player buys from the coin shop for each farm felt pointless because they didn't give a fair amount of coins. They have been buffed by 2.5.

Extended loot radius for every collectable item: Sometimes it felt like you were missing the item, even though you were clicking on it. We increased the looting radius for all collectable items to make them easier to loot. It's not always fun to click the Egg right in the center.

The frequency of mails reduced: The mails popped up too often and the frequency of them has been reduced.

Lowering music volume when achievement sound plays: It always felt a bit of a chaos when both the music and the achievement music were playing on top of each other. Therefore it was best to reduce the music by 50% while the achievement music was playing.

Future Plans
Now that all of the bugs are eliminated, we are focusing on adding new features to Farmtale. It is important for us to add more things to do while the player is waiting for more currency to spend on the pirate ship. Therefore we are currently adding features that will introduce both progression and degression.

Pirate Attacks: Pirates will occasionally discover your farm and attack you!

Tower Defense: Defend yourself against pirate attacks through mouse clicks. But at some point they get too strong and you're better off with a couple of turrets.

Diamond Currency: As you've probably already discovered, Farmtale contains diamonds that can be achieved in several ways. They will be displayed right above the Coins counter and you will be able to spend them on awesome things!

Quests: Complete quests and earn rewards.

Lumberjacks and Scrap Collectors: Hire a lumberjack to cut down trees and Scrap collectors to pick up metal. It is always our priority to make "clicking" stronger than idling. Therefore you will still make faster progress through manual clicks.

Night Workers: When you are offline, your farm is unprotected. You can't keep working all day! Therefore pirates will steal from you while you are offline. Hire Night Workers to protect your offline income.

Fishing: Throw your fishing pole and see what you catch!

Mini Game: You will see what it's all about. But we can say that the longer you reach into the mini game, the more you can brag to your friends.

Wood Collector: Another source that will gain you Material! We think that you shouldn't be limited by only having the Workshop as the Material income source (apart from trees and metal parts). Therefore we are adding a new building.

We hope to see you around in our Community Hub or Discord Server!
